lyrics:
[Intro: plucked marimba-like loop, guitar body taps, finger snaps]

[Verse 1: half rapped, close, loop and taps only]
Monday night and the dishes waiting
Your hair's still wet and the kettle's shaking
You're reading something, your foot's on mine
Six years here and I still lose time

[Pre-Chorus: bass enters, backing voices loop]
Say hey, come here, put the book down now
The plates can soak, I'll show you how

[Chorus: full groove, stacked voices]
I've got a thing for your side of the bed
The dent you leave, the things you said
The cold feet and the stolen sheet
The way you talk right through your sleep
I've got a thing for your side
Mm-hm, mm-hm
Your side of the bed

[Verse 2: half rapped, playful, kick drum added]
You leave a glass on every surface
You hum off-key and you do it on purpose
You take the left, you take the middle too
I'm on the edge and I'm fine with the view

[Pre-Chorus: bass and backing voices]
Say hey, come here, put the phone down now
The world can wait, I'll show you how

[Chorus: full groove, stacked voices]
I've got a thing for your side of the bed
The dent you leave, the things you said
The cold feet and the stolen sheet
The way you talk right through your sleep
I've got a thing for your side
Mm-hm, mm-hm
Your side of the bed

[Bridge: groove drops to voices and claps, round building]
Come on, be my morning
Come on, be my night
Come on, be the reason
I never get the light

[Final Chorus: everything, extra harmonies, ad-libs]
I've got a thing for your side of the bed
The dent you leave, the things you said
The cold feet and the stolen sheet
The way you talk right through your sleep
I've got a thing for your side
Mm-hm, mm-hm
Your side of the bed

[Outro: loop alone, a lamp clicking off]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 96 BPM, 4/4, C-sharp minor. A light, syncopated, tropical-tinged sway. Warm and easy.

VOICE: Male tenor with a soft English accent, singing in a rhythmic, half-rapped style close to the microphone. His own voice is looped and stacked for the backing parts: hums, a low 'mm-hm', and percussive breaths.

INSTRUMENTS: A short plucked pattern on a marimba-like synth, looping throughout. Percussive taps and slaps on the body of an acoustic guitar. Finger snaps and claps. A deep, simple bass. A soft kick drum. Layered vocal loops used as instruments. Occasional acoustic guitar strums.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, the plucked loop with taps and snaps. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:30 Pre-chorus, bass enters. 0:40 Chorus 1. 1:05 Verse 2, kick added. 1:25 Pre-chorus. 1:35 Chorus 2. 2:00 Bridge, the groove drops to stacked voices and claps, building as a round. 2:25 Final chorus with extra harmonies. 2:55 The hook repeats. 3:15 Outro, the loop alone and a lamp switching off at 3:25.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-2010s minimal pop: very few sounds, each one close, dry and clean, with deep sub-bass and lots of space.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The plucked loop alone in the first five seconds.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is the first night. This is year six: dishes, a wet towel, a book. Desire is found in habit, which is a later and less often sung kind.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Affectionate teasing, wanting, contentment.
